verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਇਕਾਂਤੁ ਬਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh benee bhagat kar jai ikaa(n)t bahai liv laavai|

en.bdb: Saint Beni, a gurmukh, used to sit in solitude and would enter a meditative trance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਧਿਆਤਮੀ ਹੋਰਸੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: karam karai adhiaatamee horas kisai na alakh lakhaavai|

en.bdb: He would perform spiritual activities and in humbleness would never tell anyone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਰਾਜੁ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਆਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ghar aaiaa jaa puchheeaai raaj dhuaar giaa aalaavai|

en.bdb: Reaching back home when asked, he would tell people that he had gone to the door of his king (the Supreme Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੂ ਮੰਗੀਅਨਿ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਝਤ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ghar sabh vathoo ma(n)geean val chhal kar kai jhat la(n)ghaavai|

en.bdb: When his wife asked for some household material he would avoid her and thus spend his time performing spiritual activities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਂਗੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਓਹ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: vaddaa saa(n)g varatadhaa oh ik man paramesar dhiaavai|

en.bdb: One day while concentrating on the Lord with single-minded devotion, a strange miracle happened.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ਭਗਤ ਦੀ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਚਲਿ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: paij savaarai bhagat dhee raajaa hui kai ghar chal aavai|

en.bdb: To keep the glory of the devotee, God Himself in the form of King went to his house.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਇ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਤੁਸਿ ਕੈ ਅਣਗਣਤੀ ਖਰਚੀ ਪਹੁੰਚਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhei dhilaasaa tus kai anaganatee kharachee pahu(n)chaavai|

en.bdb: In great joy, He consoled everyone and made available profuse money for expenditure.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਥਹੁੰ ਆਇਆ ਭਗਤ ਪਾਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਉਪਜਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: othahu(n) aaiaa bhagat paas hoi dhiaal het upajaavai|

en.bdb: From there He came to His devotee Beni and compassionately loved him.
This way He arranges applause for His devotees.
